label: Time, sustainment and control
text: ST.O.A4.4 — Culminating point (M15) [clausewitz-c10], [luttwak-c03], [luttwak-c04]. Sequential versus cumulative strategy (M21) [wylie-c05], [wylie-c06], [galula-c10]. Mission command under a fixed intent (M20) [tetlock-c14], [gray-c02], [mao-c08]. Friction [clausewitz-c07]. Protraction: three stages [mao-c03], the jig-saw pattern [mao-c04], the economics of a protracted campaign [suntzu-c03]. The eight-step area strategy [galula-c09]. Paradoxical logic: good road and bad road [luttwak-c01], specialization defeating itself [luttwak-c05], the oversuccessful Maginot Line [luttwak-c11]. Industry evolution [porter-c08]. Logistics (no card yet; LCC U168).

warrant.standard: The pattern recurs across protracted and short wars.
warrant.defeaters: The culminating point is identifiable only after the fact.
